jobs.occupation: Beauty, Wellness or Physiotherapy Professional  - Norway
jobs.description:
Lotus Clinic has been established for 18 years and is located inside Hotell Frøya on the island of Frøya in Trøndelag, Norway.
Over the years, we have built a large and loyal client base, and we experience strong demand for our treatments from both local residents and hotel guests.
Our clinic shares premises with a Barber Shop, creating a friendly and active environment for clients and professionals.

Our current services include:
.Massage
.Beauty and facial treatments
.Foot care
.Waxing
.Lash lifts
.Eyelash and eyebrow treatments

We are now looking for a new colleague who can strengthen our team and potentially expand the range of treatments we offer.

Who are we looking for?
We welcome applications from qualified and experienced professionals within one or more of the following areas:
.Physiotherapy
.Massage therapy
.Beauty therapy / skincare
.Foot care
.Spa and wellness therapy
.Nail design / nail technology

Experience or qualifications in several types of treatments would be an advantage, but are not required.
We are also very interested in candidates who can bring new skills or treatments to the clinic.

About you
We are looking for someone who:
.Is professional, reliable and service-minded
.Enjoys working with people
.Takes pride in providing high-quality treatments and excellent customer service
.Is comfortable working independently
.Also enjoys being part of a friendly and professional working environment
.Is flexible regarding working hours
.Is interested in developing a long-term professional relationship with the clinic

For physiotherapists, the necessary qualifications and authorisation required to practise as a physiotherapist in Norway must be obtained.

Language
You must be able to communicate well with clients and colleagues.
Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but we also welcome applications from candidates from other European countries.
Good English skills may be sufficient when starting the position, depending on your professional field and responsibilities.
A willingness to learn Norwegian over time would be an advantage.

Moving to Frøya, Norway
We warmly welcome applications from candidates living outside Norway.
For the right candidate, we can assist with finding suitable accommodation on Frøya and provide practical information to help with relocation and settling into the local community.
Frøya is located on the Trøndelag coast and offers a unique combination of professional opportunities, an active local community and beautiful coastal nature.
For someone considering a new chapter in Norway, this is an opportunity to join an established business where you do not have to start from scratch - Lotus Clinic already has an existing client base and strong demand for treatments.

How to apply
Please send us your CV and a short application in English or Norwegian.

Tell us about:
.Your education and professional qualifications
.Your work experience
.The treatments and services you can provide
.Any additional skills you could bring to Lotus Clinic
.Why you would like to work and live on Frøya

Applications will be considered on an ongoing basis.
We look forward to hearing from you - and hopefully welcoming you as our new colleague at Lotus Clinic in beautiful Frøya, Norway!

jobs.occupation: Ride On is Hiring - 2 Experienced Bicycle Mechanics | Norway 2027
jobs.description:
Ride On Bike AS is hiring two experienced bicycle mechanics!

Join our passionate team at our Canyon Service & Test Center near Oslo, Norway. Full-time positions from April to September 2027. Bring your skills and passion for cycling!

Work contract: Seasonal full-time position, for the period April to September 2027.
Working hours: 37,5 hours/week - working daytime, all weekdays
Working language: English and/or Scandinavian
Number of posts: 2

How to apply: send your CV and application by e-mail to post@ride-on.no, as soon as possible, latest by 15 December 2026

Who We Are Looking For:
We are looking for two experienced bicycle mechanics who are passionate about cycling, enjoy working with people and take pride in delivering high-quality repairs.

Required qualifications:
- Professional experience in bicycle servicing and repairs.
- Strong knowledge of modern bicycle components, including Shimano, SRAM and electronic shifting systems.
- Ability to diagnose and solve technical problems independently.
- Experience using digital workshop and diagnostic tools.
- Good communication skills in English.
- Reliable, organised and quality-focused.

Additional experience is an advantage:
- Working with racing teams or competitive cyclists.
- Suspension servicing and maintenance.
- Wheel building and truing.
- Electric bicycle systems.
- Carbon bicycle assembly and maintenance.
- Experience with Canyon or other internationally recognised bicycle brands.

We especially value people who share our passion for cycling, understand the cycling community and enjoy helping riders of all levels.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in Norway before starting employment.

Your Responsibilities:
- Perform professional bicycle servicing, maintenance and repairs.
- Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electronic issues.
- Service hydraulic brakes, drivetrains and electronic shifting systems.
- Assemble, inspect and prepare road, gravel, mountain and electric bicycles.
- Use digital diagnostic tools and workshop systems.
- Carry out safety inspections and quality checks.
- Communicate professionally with customers and colleagues.
- Help maintain an organised and efficient workshop.

What We Offer:
- Two full-time temporary positions from 1 April to 30 September 2027.
- Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, in accordance with Norwegian employment regulations.
- A modern, fully equipped bicycle workshop and official Canyon Service & Test Center.
- A friendly, international working environment with a shared passion for cycling.
- Opportunities for professional development and technical training.
- Employee discounts on cycling equipment and services.
- Assistance with finding suitable accommodation in the Oslo/Bærum area.

Accommodation costs are normally the employee's responsibility unless otherwise agreed.

At Ride On, we believe in teamwork, quality and creating great cycling experiences together.

Contact person:
Rajeev Gjelsvik Rai
General Manager / Owner
E-mail: post@ride-on.no

About Ride On Bike AS:
Ride On Bike AS is a modern bicycle workshop, retail store and official Canyon Service Partner and Test Center, located in Høvik, Bærum, just outside Oslo, Norway.

We provide professional servicing, maintenance and repairs for bicycles of all brands, including road, gravel, mountain and electric bikes.

Our workshop is equipped with modern tools and diagnostic equipment, and we take pride in technical expertise, high-quality workmanship and excellent customer service.

Ride On is more than just a bike shop. We are passionate about cycling, supporting our local cycling community and creating a welcoming environment for riders of all levels.

We believe in teamwork, sharing knowledge and delivering great experiences for our customers.

RIDE  REPAIR  REPEAT
Ride On -- More than just a bike shop.

Website: https://ride-on.no/verksted

jobs.occupation: Tractor Driver
jobs.description:

We are a vegetable farm in Sylling, Lier, approximately 40 km west of Oslo. We grow iceberg lettuce, Chinese cabbage, cauliflower, and kale.

Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. 

Other duties include:
.Moving and handling irrigation equipment
.Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery
.Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities
.Loading and unloading produce and equipment
.Helping with planting, harvesting, and other physical farm work when needed

What we are looking for
.Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery
.A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE
.Ability to speak and understand English
.Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

.Seasonal employment from April to September 2027
.NOK 190-215 per hour before tax, depending on experience and qualifications

John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager
holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

jobs.occupation: Privat hushållerska/Private Housekeeper
jobs.description:
ENGLISH BELOW
Privat hushållerska
För en svensk företagare bosatt i Göteborg, Sverige, och Nice, Frankrike, söker vi en privat hushållerska. 
Arbetsuppgifterna innebär att sköta en stor bostad i centrala Göteborg och inkluderar:
• Städning
• Tvättning och strykning
• Skötsel av växter
• Vård av möbler
• Matlagning (ett veganskt mål per dag)
Lönen är 217,89 kr/h plus 12% semesterersättning och boende erbjuds, antingen i bostadens jungfrukammare eller i en närliggande separat lägenhet.
Arbetstiden uppskattas till 25-40 h per vecka, och kan delvis anpassas efter dina önskemål. Tjänsten, som utgör en vanlig anställning med full lön, kan även passa dig som överväger arbete som au pair.
För att ansöka, skriv en ärlig presentation av dig (personlighet, kunskaper inom hushållning och planer i livet), utan att använda AI, på det språk du föredrar, och skicka denna tillsammans med meritförteckning till housekeeper@servia.com.

Private Housekeeper
On behalf of a Swedish entrepreneur, residing in Gothenburg, Sweden, and Nice, France, we are looking for a private housekeeper.
The role involves looking after a large residence in central Gothenburg and includes:
• Cleaning
• Laundry and ironing
• Plant care
• Furniture care
• Cooking (one vegan meal per day)
The salary is SEK 217.89 per hour plus 12% holiday pay, and accommodation is provided, either in the residence's maid's quarters or in a nearby separate apartment.
Working hours are estimated at 25–40 hours per week and can partly be adapted to your preferences. The position, which is regular employment with full pay, may also suit you if you are considering work as an au pair.
To apply, write an honest presentation of yourself (personality, housekeeping skills and plans in life), without using AI, in your preferred language, and send it together with your CV to housekeeper@servia.com.

jobs.occupation: Build Luxuary Boats in Sweden
jobs.description:
Join Windy Scandinavia in Västervik building exclusive boats! Seeking craftsmen in fiberglass, carpentry, electrical & mechanics. Full-time with housing available.

Windy Scandinavia, a well-known brand in the boat industry, develops and manufactures exclusive boats that are becoming larger and more technically advanced. The boat models range from 26 to 77 feet.
Eterni is now looking for craftsmen to strengthen Windys production team in Västervik.

CURRENT JOB ROLES
Plastic Processing & Lamination: You work with everything from hand lay-up and injection to mold work and sanding.
Assembly & Carpentry: You assemble interiors, custom-fit wooden parts, decks, and equipment with high precision.
Marine Electronics & Electrical Installation: You install wiring, electrical systems, navigation equipment, and advanced control systems.
Mechanics & Engine Installation: You install engines, drivetrains, hydraulics, and plumbing systems.
Surface Treatment & Finish/Polish: You ensure that gelcoat, paint, and surfaces are absolutely world-class before delivery.

PERSONAL QUALITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS
We are looking for both those of you who have experience in boat building or alternatively have professional skills that are applicable within boat construction.
To succeed in your role, it is important that you:
Have high craftsmanship skills and are good with tools.
Are used to working with high demands for precision.
Are humble and are happy to lend a helping hand to others in the company.
Understand and can read and work based on drawings and instructions.
Swedish or English language is required, both spoken and written.

ABOUT THE POSITION
The job as a craftsman is a full-time consulting assignment. You will be employed by Eterni and work with Windy Scandinavia. See the website windyboats.com. Accommodation is available in Västervik. Availability to work two shifts is a requirement.

OTHER INFORMATION
Apply by registering at eterni.se and attach your CV and cover letter. For questions, contact Linda Malmros at 070-340 86 33, linda.malmros@eterni.se.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!

jobs.occupation: Long-term positions for nurses in beautiful Western Norway
jobs.description:

We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within municipal healthcare services in Western Norway.
The positions are connected to nursing homes and home-based care services, where you will have the opportunity to work closely with patients and contribute to safe, high-quality healthcare services.
The workplace is beautifully located between fjords, high mountains and spectacular scenery. The area offers excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year, while still providing easy access to a larger town within approximately 40 minutes by car.
Here, you will find a working environment that offers responsibility, professional challenges and good opportunities to develop your experience within municipal healthcare. You will become part of a workplace characterised by cooperation, quality and professional commitment.
Your responsibilities
Clinical nursing in home care, nursing homes or assisted living facilities
Observation, assessment, medication management and accurate documentation
Follow-up of patients with diverse medical conditions and functional levels
Collaboration with relatives, coordinating units and external partners
Interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and other health professionals
Contributing to service development, improvement work and quality assurance

We are looking for nurses who:
Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU/EEA country
Previous experience in home care services or nursing homes is preferred
Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments
Speak and write English fluently
Motivated to learn Norwegian
Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN)
Hold a category B driving licence 

Personal qualities:
Responsible, structured and solution oriented
Positive attitude and good teamwork skills
Flexible and comfortable with varied tasks
Motivated to contribute to a small but highly competent interdisciplinary team

We offer:
A full-time permanent position in the Norwegian public healthcare system
Competitive salary and working conditions
A supportive work environment that values cooperation and professional confidence
Opportunities for further development as a nurse
Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
Relocation assistance and help with housing
Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process 

Ready to apply?
Send us your application and we will evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis. Feel free to reach out for more information. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Hostel / Hotel Manager
jobs.description:
HOSTEL / HOTEL MANAGER
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Hostel / Hotel Manager to join our growing hospitality company in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining team management with the practical, day-to-day operation of a hostel.
Who we are looking for
Fluent and confident in English, both spoken and written.
Preferably 3+ years of experience in hospitality, including experience in a managerial or supervisory role.
Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.
Follows the set procedures and makes sure that his team does so as well.
Comfortable using computers, basic Excel and different online systems and tools.
Confident managing, supporting and motivating a small team.
Hands-on and willing to help with cleaning, maintenance or other practical tasks when needed.
Positive, communicative and social, with an interest in travel, hospitality and meeting people from around the world.
Able to work independently, take initiative and solve problems as they arise.

The role
As Hostel / Hotel Manager, you are responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the property. Your responsibilities include:
Managing and overseeing a small on-site team of 1–3 people.
Working in the hostel reception and assisting guests when needed.
Planning staff schedules and coordinating daily tasks.
Overseeing daily operations, supplies, linen orders and general organization.
Ensuring that rooms and common areas meet our cleanliness and quality standards.
Assisting with cleaning when needed.
Handling minor maintenance and practical issues.
Communicating and coordinating with our online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel's operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. As manager, you have flexibility to organize your own schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company operating hostels in central Stockholm, with the ambition to build an international hostel group characterized by Scandinavian design and the Nomad concept.
Our organization combines an on-site team with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are excellent opportunities to grow with the company and take on greater responsibility as we expand.
What we offer
Salary: 30,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in an international environment, meet people from all over the world and have the opportunity to develop your management, hospitality and communication skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

jobs.occupation: Rewarding Nursing Careers in Sweden's North
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a dedicated nurse looking to take your skills to new heights while immersing yourself in the unique lifestyle of northern Europe?
We’re seeking experienced general nurses to join healthcare teams across Northern Sweden – a region known for its stunning landscapes, tight-knit communities, and excellent working conditions.
Why Northern Sweden?
Northern Sweden offers more than just a job – it offers a lifestyle. Imagine finishing your shift and stepping out into fresh, clean air, surrounded by forests, lakes, and snow-capped mountains. This region is perfect for those who value space, calm, and a closer connection to nature. You’ll experience the beauty of the midnight sun in summer and the northern lights in winter – all while working in one of the most advanced healthcare systems in the world.
About the role
As a general nurse, you will play a vital role in delivering compassionate, high-quality care in settings such as:
Regional hospitals, where teamwork and acute care go hand in hand
Health centers and outpatient clinics focused on continuity and community care
Administering treatments, supporting patient recovery, and contributing to care planning
Working alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve patient outcomes and innovate care delivery

What we’re looking for
EU-recognized nursing license and degree
Proficiency in English and readiness to learn Swedish
A flexible, team-oriented approach and solid nursing experience
A genuine passion for patient-centered care

What you’ll get
Career development in a forward-thinking healthcare environment
Work-life balance that supports your well-being
Support throughout the process – from licensing to relocation
Free personalized Swedish language training via Teams or Skype
Assistance with accommodation and family relocation, if needed

Curious about life in the North?
Let’s talk. We’re happy to tell you more about the region, the roles, and how we support you every step of the way. Apply today to stay in the loop about upcoming opportunities for nurses across Sweden.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.
